name: Faction Atlas
description: A sourced, neutral reference map of American political and religious-political factions, the people and organizations in them, and how they relate, with every claim linked to a public source.
method: Public figures and organizations are placed in factions from public evidence: actions first, then their own words, then ties. Attendance or appearances alone never place anyone. Factions are organization/community, ideology/single-issue, or coalition factions; each entry has one exclusive home at the coalition level. Every claim links to a public source, and wording is neutral.

use_note: Other Atlases may index this file and compare their placements and faction structure against it. It is a comparison source, not evidence: each Atlas should check any suggestion against its own public sources.
